response.sql:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(GOT) AS overall_avg_got
  FROM Laboratory
), patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT ID,
         AVG(GOT) AS avg_got,
         AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT p.ID,
       p.avg_got,
       p.avg_rbc,
       p.avg_got - o.overall_avg_got AS got_difference
FROM patient_avgs AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg_got IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY got_difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average GOT is calculated across all non-NULL GOT values in Laboratory; patients with no GOT values still appear when that overall average exists, with a missing difference sorted last.
